text:
nina: Planning a coordinated rollout tonight 22:45 UTC. Services: api v3.4.0 (minor header gating), runtime v10.1.0 (kernel selector tweak), router v1.7.0 (routing-table split + header normalization), console v2.2.0. Need a safe order, pin strategy, and smoke tests.

alex: Suggestion: do a small smoke of runtime first behind header gate before touching router. Router normalization might strip our experimental header.

nina: Good point. If router normalizes headers we must keep `preserve-headers=true` for the first 2 waves. Also prefer order: api -> runtime-smoke -> router -> runtime full -> console. Rollback reverse.

devops-bot: Proposed waves created by @nina:
- wave-1 api v3.4.0 2024-05-10 22:45 UTC  canary 3% -> 15% -> 100% (10m holds)
- wave-2 runtime v10.1.0 (smoke) 23:00 UTC  gated by header `x-canary-runtime: v10` (1% smoke for 10m)
- wave-3 router v1.7.0 23:15 UTC  `preserve-headers=true` for 20m, gradual routing-table split
- wave-4 runtime v10.1.0 (full) 23:35 UTC  expand canary 5% -> 25%
- wave-5 console v2.2.0 23:55 UTC  feature-flag behind, enable after verification

devops-bot: Rollback handlers: `deployctl rollback <service>` -> last-stable. Manual confirm required for cross-service rollbacks.

ops-runbook-bot: Quick auto-pause rules:
```
api_p95 > 1s for 5m
api_error_rate > 1% 5m
router_header_drop > 5/m
runtime_kernel_oom >=1 node in 5m
console_ui_error_rate > 4% 10m
```
Auto-pause will halt the current wave and ping @oncall. Escalation steps in runbook.

alex: I'll own the runtime smoke and kernel telemetry. Plan to run `infra/smoke/runtime-selector-check.sh --header x-canary-runtime:v10` and compare `kv-check` across variants.

qa-bot: Adding automated KV parity check to the smoke: `qa/smoke/kv-parity --header x-canary-runtime:v10` returns pass/fail in 2m.

nina: Pin note: Hold API pinned to old router routes until router reaches 25% and no header drops for two 10m intervals. Use route-pin tag on API deploy.

alex: Also lock router sidecars to not rewrite `x-canary-runtime`. I'll add sidecar exemption label for canary slice.

nina: Release note draft (embargo until +45m after final wave): "Runtime kernel selector updates for perf; routing table split to improve pathing; API header gating for controlled runtime canaries; console UI fixes."

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook snippet: if runtime_kernel_oom -> rollback runtime immediately. If router_header_drop persists after preserve flip -> rollback router and re-pin api. If api_p95 stays high after 2 holds -> rollback api. Notify #incidents and @oncall.

alex: Acks: I'll monitor kernel OOMs and have `deployctl rollback runtime` ready.

qa-bot: I'll start the KV parity check right after runtime smoke wave.

nina: Finalizing order: api -> runtime-smoke -> router (preserve-headers) -> runtime full -> console. Rollback reverse. Embargo until 00:30 UTC. Everyone ack. :thumbsup:

alex: ack

qa-bot: ack

devops-bot: wave-1 started 22:45 UTC  api canary 3%

devops-bot: wave-1 stable at 3% for 10m, progressing to 15%

(see runbook for live updates)
